subject.title: fix(agents): bound IDENTITY.md reads to prevent OOM

question: Should explicit `openclaw agents set-identity --identity-file` imports adopt the same 2 MiB cap already used for workspace bootstrap files, even though existing larger identity files will now be rejected?
rationale: The branch intentionally turns a previously unbounded explicit import into a fail-closed command path; code review alone cannot decide whether that upgrade behavior is the desired public contract.

options.title: Accept the shared 2 MiB boundary
options.body: Keep the shared cap for both paths after exact-head CLI proof confirms the normal and oversized behaviors.

options.title: Preserve larger explicit imports
options.body: Keep the workspace cap but choose a separately documented policy for explicit files if compatibility with larger existing imports is required.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared 2 MiB boundary
recommendation.body: Keep the shared cap for both paths after exact-head CLI proof confirms the normal and oversized behaviors.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest review timeline routes this identity-area compatibility question to samzong, though repository history could not be inspected here.
